scope: 高中离子方程式拆写与 Equation Lab 模式投影。

phase_gate.notes_zh: 同一化学式在不同相态下拆写规则不同；相态优先于物质默认属性。

soluble_salt_rule: If substance.aqueous_behavior == strong_electrolyte and participant phase == aq, project substance.ions using stored integer coefficients.
insoluble_rule: Substances marked insoluble or sparingly_soluble remain unsplit when written as precipitates/solids.
sulfuric_acid_note_zh: 普通高中净离子方程式中通常将稀硫酸按强电解质拆写；涉及 HSO4- 的精细逐级电离问题应进入专门酸碱平衡语境。

mode_rules.molecular: show Substance participants; hide ion-only palette by default
mode_rules.ionic: split eligible strong electrolytes in aqueous phase; retain weak electrolytes, gases, precipitates and water
mode_rules.net_ionic: apply ionic projection, cancel unchanged spectator ions, then verify atom and total-charge conservation
